name: com.attribloom/mcp
title: Attribloom
description: Affiliate attribution and commission data for iOS (StoreKit 2) and Shopify

environmentVariables.name: ATTRIBLOOM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tenant API key from the Attribloom dashboard (Settings, API keys). Optional: the two guidance tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: ATTRIBLOOM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Management API base URL. Defaults to https://api.attribloom.com
